## Independence and current governing basis

Independent agent /root/independent_delivery_review authored none of the plan, Design, implementation or final correction. This agent's prior work was independent Delivery assessment only. The parent authored the engineering contributions and now proposes the bounded correction under recorded final review findings.

The primary plan remains sha256:5f1f00d9e756e084670fb0acf094f7f45a25a850fbc1de88f9ea4fd0cd9260c4, exactly the complete plan read and approved in Delivery round 2. The current Skill is sha256:b2a9edc9b9fea3fd45e168e64ad0d2db9a8550f1308f303ede49f2cdcd70feaf. Replacing only its new first applicability sentence with the old sentence reproduces the previously approved Skill identity, sha256:6c15e11c170ba7886439ba6db6c6cfd220438532b154d19be65fc0e424cfa767. System and plan bytes are unchanged. The complete fresh Design r3 judgment was read and approves this governing package; the original reporter resolved skl-cr-002. Previous exact-subject judgments remain historical rather than retargeted.

Reuse is limited to round 2's complete-plan sequencing/proof assessment and unchanged governing requirements. Current implemented consumers and proof are not assumed byte-identical to their preimplementation basis. This review freshly considers the final findings, current corrected Design, unchanged plan's relevant allocations and actual stale test/CI entrypoints. The final whole-change reviewer and Verify retain responsibility for implementation and actual proof sufficiency.

## Design correction and Delivery trace

The corrected opening sentence states stable conditional adoption. All following review, implementation and successful-Verify prerequisites, population boundaries, precise retained rules, source dispositions, examples and SKL requirements remain unchanged. Therefore the same two milestones, SKL-SR-01–23, scoped SYS-SR-02/04/06/07, local groups and integrated group still allocate the complete approved behavior. No new requirement, execution order or proof boundary needs a plan amendment.

M2 already requires exact operational/current/historical consumer disposition, preservation of useful source/validator protection and appropriate reassessment of any changed engineering authority. TG-04 requires preserving useful assertions; TG-05 requires actual consumers to resolve correctly. TG-FINAL-01 requires final current-reference/operational-consumer inspection against actual files, not reliance on an earlier package pass. The final checkpoint explicitly includes all required corrections before fresh whole-change review and distinct Verify. These allocations cover a newly exposed stale test consumer without adding a third skill pilot or changing specialist behavior.

## Bounded lifecycle fixture and composed proof

The inspected test still reads skills/architecture/assets/architecture-skeleton.md before its existing ARCHITECTURE_CONTRACT.required_sections parity assertion. Correcting only that lookup to the existing Design-owned skills/design/assets/legacy-architecture-skeleton.md restores the intended oracle. It does not retire the assertion or add an implementation-derived expected result. The full lifecycle regression suite, including the parity case, must pass after repair as skl-cr-003 requires. This review does not claim that repair or run has happened.

The plan expressly permits proof reuse only for an actual previous passing result with exact proved surface/environment and an affirmative unaffected basis; relevant new subjects or conflicting evidence require fresh proof. Thus successful unchanged broad children may be combined with a fresh complete lifecycle regression and exact-current-subject v2 lifecycle/record checks. The original broad command remains failed. No aggregate pass may relabel it, hide a failed child, waive a required outcome or restore a retired runtime adapter.

scripts/ci.sh exposes --skip-diff-scoped for broad smoke as an existing supported invocation. Using the current v2 validation path for a current v2 root preserves governing runtime authority; it is not a policy change or acceptance of the legacy adapter's rejection as a pass. Exact-current-subject final PR CI, as proposed by the implementer, supplies fresh integration evidence in addition to scoped reuse; the plan does not forbid such relevant fresh proof. Any missing current surface, altered child dependency/environment or newly failed applicable check defeats that reuse basis and must be corrected before completion.

This composition follows the plan's explicit applicability policy and retained Test/Review and Closeout criteria. It requires inspectable child results, exact scope/freshness rationale and independent final assessment. The open Code Review finding remains with its reporter until actual proof supports disposition. Delivery approval does not itself resolve it or waive Verify's separate judgment.

## Checks and limits

Performed read-only git diff, current Skill applicability read, plan allocation/reuse/final-checkpoint inspection, exact plan and Skill hash comparison, final-r1 finding/result inspection, current stale fixture and actual CI option inspection, fresh Design r3 read, primary scoped context and full subject inspection, and targeted review recording. Initial combined context selection was truncated; per-kind queries for reviews, findings, applicability, plan, models and blockers established complete selected scope before reliance. No implementation tests, package generation or CI ran during this review. No engineering change or blanket source/test deletion is approved by this receipt.
independence_basis: Independent reviewer authored no plan, Design, implementation or correction; prior work was assessment only. It freshly assesses unchanged-plan applicability against approved Design r3 and final recorded findings without engineering edits.
